result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of basic sidewalks on both sides of a wide roadway, but lacks any formal crossing infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or pedestrian signals at the visible intersection, leaving pedestrians exposed to traffic in a poorly defined space.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians crossing the street have no designated or protected space, increasing the risk of conflict with vehicles.

hazards.name: Absence of curb ramps
hazards.description: The lack of sloped transitions makes the sidewalk inaccessible for people with mobility aids or strollers.

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven road surface can cause tripping hazards or unpredictable vehicle movements.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with sidewalks on both sides but a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control devices visible, creating an environment where pedestrians must cross wide, unmarked pavement with no designated right-of-way.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted crosswalks, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected space to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate vehicle flow or speed at the intersection.

hazards.name: Faded Pavement Markings
hazards.description: Existing lane markings are significantly worn and faded, reducing clarity for drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra or ladder-style pavement markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs or other traffic calming measures to manage vehicle speeds and clarify right-of-way.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with sidewalks on both sides and a faded zebra-style crosswalk. While a modern curb ramp with tactile paving is visible on the left, the lack of traffic control signs and faded markings reduce pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A vehicle parked close to the intersection on the left may block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate vehicle flow at this intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions or curb extensions near the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or a raised crosswalk to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential area.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features basic infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk, though the markings are significantly faded. The roadway exhibits poor pavement quality with extensive cracking, and there is a lack of active traffic control or pedestrian-specific signage at the crossing.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk is heavily worn, reducing its visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Extensive cracking and uneven surfaces in the roadway and crossing area create potential trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the intersection and crossing area

hazards.name: Lack of crossing signage
hazards.description: There are no pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using high-visibility thermoplastic zebra markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install standard pedestrian crossing warning signs (W11-2) to alert motorists of the designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and provide a smooth, accessible path for pedestrians.
